{{Top|leg}}
The '''JC-671 deflector shield generator''' or '''JC-671 projector''' was a type of [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] manufactured by [[Delphus/Legends|Delphus]] for use on [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], including the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']] and ''[[Far Orbit]]''.
